description_en: Modifies the name, description, and peak bandwidth of a specified elastic IP address (EIP)
description_zh: 调用ModifyEnsEipAddressAttribute修改指定EIP的名称、描述信息和带宽峰值
kebab_example: aliyun ens modify-ens-eip-address-attribute --allocation-id eip-5sw5dxzgi6umq4uexxkt8wpma --name test-api-modify --description abc --bandwidth 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEnsEipAddressAttribute

parameters.description_en: The new name of the EIP. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://.
parameters.description_zh: 需要修改的EIP的名称。长度为2~128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
parameters.help_en: The new name of the EIP. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的EIP的名称。长度为2~128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en: The new description of the EIP. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://.
parameters.description_zh: 需要修改的EIP描述信息。长度为2~256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
parameters.help_en: The new description of the EIP. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://

parameters.name: description

parameters.description_en: The peak bandwidth of the EIP. Default value: 5. Valid values: **5** to **10000**. Unit: Mbit/s.
parameters.description_zh: EIP的带宽峰值，默认值为5。取值范围：**5**~**10000**，单位：Mbps。
